title: The Dream Museum
label: STUDY 01 / NIGHT GALLERY
concept: A museum for the things you almost dreamed.
intro: At midnight, a small film society opens a museum with no objects to own. Cam records the shadows. Else manages the nowhere desk. Ghostlight keeps one room open. Prism lends visitors a color they have never felt before.
influence: A nod to midnight cinema, exhibition catalogs and surreal architectural stage sets. Every character and story is original to this collection.

pieces.title: Admission Is a State of Mind
pieces.hook: Bring nothing. Leave a little larger.
pieces.narrative: Cam and Else arrive at an impossible gallery. The doorway is the only exhibit that has not decided where it leads.

pieces.title: The Elsewhere Desk
pieces.hook: Somewhere for the part of you that wandered.
pieces.narrative: A catalog card for an unlocatable room. Else does not give directions; Else makes room.

pieces.title: A Color You Can Borrow
pieces.hook: Return it when the world feels wider.
pieces.narrative: Prism lends color with no due date. The small gold circle is the deposit: one moment of attention.

selectedCharacters.name: Cam
selectedCharacters.oneLiner: Finds the shot everyone else walks past.
selectedCharacters.bio: The club's tiny documentary director records the moments before anyone says action. Cam is making a film about an empty chair and has already found three endings.

selectedCharacters.name: Ghostlight
selectedCharacters.oneLiner: Keeps the theatre welcoming after the audience goes home.
selectedCharacters.bio: The club's gentle night custodian hears stories in every creaking floorboard. Ghostlight leaves one light on for the show that has not found its cast yet.

selectedCharacters.name: Else
selectedCharacters.oneLiner: Makes space for the question that does not fit.
selectedCharacters.bio: The observatory's keeper of mysteries resists the urge to explain everything away. Else files unsolved questions under 'worth another evening.'

selectedCharacters.name: Prism
selectedCharacters.oneLiner: Finds the colour hiding inside a grey day.
selectedCharacters.bio: The observatory's light artist turns everyday reflections into installations. Prism's favourite studio equipment is a glass of water beside a window.
